title: Technology is helping my fellow math teachers trade weekend prep for personalized learning.
subject: 综合学习
why_useful: 这是有明确学习入口的练习册，适合家长或教师筛选后转给孩子做拓展学习。
qiba_angle: 七爸写法可从“今天发现一个可以立刻用的学习资源”切入，说明适合谁、怎么用、不要怎么用。
summary: Teachers use Gemini to build custom K-6 math worksheets and save hours of prep time. See how Google AI transforms classroom instruction.
